evidence.C1: Koi are recognisable with varied patterns (kohaku, showa, ogon visible) and the pond has stone rim, moss, lanterns, lily pads, bamboo fountain; night scene shows lantern glow and moon reflection, but koi bodies look somewhat flat/stylised and water depth, while present, lacks the convincing depth of a 'leave open on a second screen' pond.
evidence.C2: Calm full-screen mode (last screenshot) hides all UI and looks finished; bottom toolbar is quiet and minimal; scene dominates in calm mode; however the persistent bottom toolbar in normal mode slightly competes with the scene.
evidence.C3: Rich interaction set: tap water for ripple, hold to feed, drag to lead koi, tap koi for name card, tap leaf to spin, plus keys Space/F/R/M/H/Esc; soundscape has stream, fountain, chimes, crickets, rain, plops, pellet ticks, gulps with positional panning; sleep timer with fade-out and dim.
evidence.C4: Desktop toolbar is tidy and well-spaced; phone (390) layout fits pond and stacks controls cleanly; Sounds sheet is well-grouped into Volume/Layers/Mood/Koi count/Sleep timer sections; minor: koi count and sleep timer pill rows could be slightly more refined.

fixes: Improve koi form and depth — bodies still read as somewhat flat/stylised blobs in places; add more shading, fin detail, and scale texture so they look convincing rather than cartoonish.
Enhance water depth and caustic light — current caustics are subtle; stronger underwater gradient, light shafts, and bottom texture would push the pond toward 'second screen' quality.
Make the bottom toolbar auto-hide or more minimal in normal mode so the scene dominates even outside full-screen calm mode, reducing UI competition with the pond.

evidence.C1: Pleasant, coherent pond with varied koi ('9 koi varieties... bodies bend as they swim; fins, tail, patterns, shadows') and light that changes across day/dusk/night (lantern glow, moon reflection, fireflies). But several koi read flat and banana/leaf-shaped (the yellow ogon), and the water texture is uniform speckle noise, so depth and 'convincing form' fall short of the 10 anchor.
evidence.C2: Calm mode looks finished: dusk shot is full-bleed scene with only a faint eye icon ('calm full-screen mode with all UI hidden'), and the night shot shows no jarring UI. But the default desktop view keeps Level/coins/nav chrome, heading, stats line and a 5-button pill over the pond, so the scene does not fully dominate by default.
evidence.C3: Beyond the 7 anchor ('feeding, ripples and a few sound toggles') it adds 'tap... hold to feed, drag to lead koi, tap a koi for its name card, tap a leaf to spin it' plus 'volume, layer toggles, mood, koi count 5/9/13, sleep timer 10/20/30 min that fades out and dims' and position-panned layers. Only deduction: drag-to-lead and leaf-spin have no visible hint in any screenshot, so discoverability of the full set is unproven.
evidence.C4: Tidy at both sizes with no overflow; the mixer sheet is 'clear and well grouped' (Volume / Layers with % readouts / Mood / Koi in the pond / Sleep timer, with helpful notes like 'Crickets only sing in night mood'). Small flaw: on the 390 px pill the 'Sound on' button stacks icon over label while Feed/Rain/Sounds are inline, a minor inconsistency.

fixes: C1 (w=0.35, biggest lever): give koi convincing volume - body shading, dorsal fin, softer pattern edges, fix the banana-shaped yellow koi - and break up the uniform water speckle with deeper darks and varied caustics so the water reads as having depth.

C2: auto-fade the bottom control pill and the stats line after a few idle seconds (reappear on hover/touch/motion) so the default view is scene-first instead of calm mode being the only quiet state; ensure the night view keeps a subtle affordance to restore controls.

C4/C3: on 390 px make the 'Sound on' button match its siblings' inline icon+label layout (or make all five uniform), and add a one-time hint ('hold to feed, drag to lead, tap a koi to meet it') so the hidden gestures are discoverable.
